title: Someone put over a 100 fully finished apps on GitHub, the repo already has a hundred thousand stars
description:
Someone put 100+ fully finished apps on GitHub for free, and the repo already has 100,000 stars.

These aren't tutorials. They're the finished, production-ready apps. Launch one as your own, put a subscription on top, or use it as the base layer and build something bigger.

But the code was never the hard part. If free apps made you rich, everyone who cloned this repo would be a millionaire. Building it is 10%. Getting one human to use it is the other 90%.

The repo isn't the cheat code. Distribution is.

Comment BUILD and I'll send you the repo.
